Module com.mathcat.mathcat
Package com.mathcat.mathcat.models

Class Question

java.lang.Object
com.mathcat.mathcat.models.Question
All Implemented Interfaces:
IQuestion
public class Question extends Object implements IQuestion
Represents a math question generated from a set of operands, QuestionType, and a Difficulty. Computes the answer and builds the question text at construction time.

  • Constructor Details

    • Question

      public Question(QuestionType questionType, Difficulty difficulty, int[] operands)
      Constructs a math question from the given type, difficulty, and operands. Computes the answer and formats the question text at construction time.
      Parameters:
      questionType - the aritmetic operation for this question
      difficulty - the difficulty level
      operands - the numbers used, between 2 and 6 inclusive
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if operands length is outside of the valid range
